title: The Episode About the Hill chief of Kebloor

blocks.text: Banda now explicitly selects five Singhs for the assault and empowers them with blessings, weapons, and precise battlefield purposes.
Their departure is ceremonial as well as tactical, because the chosen band embodies concentrated Khalsa will rather than mere numerical force.
These five Singhs mark the page’s center: chosen, named, and sent as the cutting edge of the campaign.
